study_name: CGMacros: a scientific dataset for personalized nutrition and diet monitoring
treatment_modalities: Continuous Glucose Monitoring,Food Macronutrient Logging,Physical Activity Tracking,Gut Microbiome Profiling
study_description: A dataset containing multimodal information from two CGMs, food macronutrients, food photographs, and physical activity, from 45 participants (15 healthy, 16 pre-diabetes, 14 Type 2 diabetes) over ten consecutive days.
